entries.gave: Read invoicer as the accounting colleague meets it: the invoicer command, how it reads the saved lines, and the printed invoice, with its setup in pyproject.toml

Read N8 in the code best practice: refuse a wrong outside input before acting, with a message that names the program, what is wrong, where, and what is accepted; catch only fixable errors by type; checks that survive python -O

Answered N8 in more: an unclosed quotation mark in the saved file ends in a traceback naming no row in a long file, and in a short one a message that hides the quote; every other wrong input ran is refused before printing, with a fixable message
N8, the one condition of the group, is answered in the Answers
